claims.statement: The EU Medical Device Regulation requires each manufacturer to plan, document, maintain, and update a post-market surveillance system for each device.
The Medical Device Coordination Group published dedicated post-market surveillance guidance in December 2025.

contrary_evidence: Manufacturers may refuse pooled benchmarking because complaint data are commercially and legally sensitive.
Established quality-management platforms already cover complaint workflows.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: partner with notified-body advisers, PRRC consultants, and small device accelerators.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 400 device families and a defensible failure benchmark could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in eight to eleven years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: a regulatory partner reviews outputs while founder work remains below 20 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: automated normalization could reach 65% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: acquisition pays back with the first annual device-family contract.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 18,000 PLN per device family yearly plus 6,000 PLN per safety report.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: continuous surveillance and periodic reporting create multi-year retention.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned cross-manufacturer failure taxonomy improves signal detection and benchmark value
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed surveillance intake, trend detection, report drafting, and anonymized peer benchmarks
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays annually per device family and when a formal report is produced
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A manufacturer must continuously analyze complaints and update post-market evidence

founder_fit: Health interest and statistical signal detection are strong founder matches.
A qualified regulatory partner is essential because data science alone is insufficient.
risks: Missed safety signals could create severe liability and reputational harm.
Anonymization may be insufficient for rare devices or incidents.

structure.control_point: Complaint intake and normalized evidence feeding each periodic safety report
structure.critical_dependency: Manufacturer data-sharing contracts and quality-system integration

thesis: Pool permissioned complaint and device-performance records so small manufacturers can produce better surveillance reports and benchmarks.
title: Medical-Device Post-Market Evidence Cooperative
uncertainties: The cooperative's lawful data model and benchmark usefulness are unvalidated.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
